newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK SAX DOWN ON LOSSES TO SLOVAKOFARMA, NAFTA.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK SAX DOWN ON LOSSES TO SLOVAKOFARMA, NAFTA.

text.p: Sharp losses to shares of Slovak drug maker Slovakofarma and oil storage company Nafta led the Bratislava Stock Exchange SAX index 2.2 percent lower in thin trading on Tuesday.
The 16-share SAX dropped 3.77 points to close at 167.54, but dealers said the drop came in another session of scant activity.
"There is no firm trend on the market, the volume is thin, there is no liquidity and the market can move up or down at will," said Peter Krutil of Creditanstalt.
Slovakofarma closed at 4,322 crowns, a loss of 398 or 8.4 percent lower than its Monday level, while Nafta shed 103 crowns to close 8.2 percent lower at 1,097.
Another major loser on Tuesday was antibiotics producer Biotika, a Slovakofarma subsidiary, which closed 161 crowns lower at 463, a drop of 23.1 percent.
Steelmaker VSZ the BSE's most liquid share in the past few months, and oil refiner Slovanaft , the most heavily weighted SAX issue, did not trade at all on Tuesday.

Overall volume rose to 100,979 shares from 52,647 on Monday, while turnover edged up to 57.683 million crowns from Monday's 41.60 million crowns. Both overall volume and turnover consisted mainly of direct trades.
